title: Anogenital Skin and Mucous Membrane Lesions

questions.lead_in: What is the most likely sexually transmitted disease to be the cause of the findings in the photograph?
questions.explanation: Syphilis The image shows significant keratitis and hypopyon as seen with anterior uveitis. Syphilis can have a variety of ocular manifestations including anterior uveitis, which is most commonly seen during secondary syphilis, posterior uveitis and retinitis, and interstitial keratitis that is a late sequela of congenital infection. Herpes simplex virus could also be considered in the differential diagnosis. (Image from Assessments. In Cohen J, Powderly W , Opal S, eds. Infectious Diseases. 4th ed. Elsevier; 2017.)
questions.source: Comprehensive Review of ID · Quiz 6 Q34

cohort_answer.text: HSV 1+2; Chancroid (Haemophilus ducreyi); Syphilis; LGV; Granuloma inguinale (Klebsiella granulomatis). Table with details: HSV - multiple small grouped ulcers, incubation 2-7d, usually painful, reactive painful nodes; Chancroid - incubation 3-10d, ++ pain, unilateral painful inguinal LN can rupture/purulent; Syphilis - indurated smooth firm-bordered single ulcer, clean base, heals spontaneously, incubation 7-90d, usually painless, firm rubbery nontender nodes; LGV - Chlamydia trachomatis L1-L3, usually no visible ulcer, incubation 5-21d, usually painless, M>F clusters, painful groove sign, sinus tracts common; Granuloma inguinale - extensive progressive granulation tissue with rolled edges, incubation 7-90d, usually painless, pseudobuboes

questions.question: List 3 pathogens (genus and species) in which Doxycycline CAN be considered for treatment for genital ulcers.

parts.text: List 3 pathogens (genus and species) in which Doxycycline CAN be considered for treatment for genital ulcers.

questions.model_answer: Three genital ulcer pathogens for which doxycycline can be considered: (1) Treponema pallidum (syphilis - doxycycline 100 mg PO BID x14 days is an alternative to penicillin). (2) Chlamydia trachomatis (lymphogranuloma venereum - doxycycline 100 mg PO BID x14-21 days). (3) Klebsiella granulomatis (donovanosis/granuloma inguinale - doxycycline for a minimum of 3 weeks or until lesions heal).
